note: 单元通关专属迷你阅读(野生动物保护主题,独立短文,不在阅读关出现)。短文2-3句+2题,答案转述非照抄,2题覆盖不同位置。

finalReading.passage: In a small town, a teenager named Sam noticed that the wild ducks by the river were disappearing fast. Instead of staying silent, he made a bright poster asking people to stop selling the birds and started cleaning the riverbank every weekend. A year later, the ducks had returned, and many of his neighbours had joined him to care for them.

questions.q: What did Sam do after noticing the ducks were disappearing?
options: He made a poster and cleaned the riverbank every weekend.
He kept silent and did nothing.
He moved away from the town.
He started selling the wild ducks himself.
questions.explanation: 原文 'made a bright poster… started cleaning the riverbank every weekend' 的转述;其余与原文相反或未提。

questions.q: What happened in the town a year later?
options: The ducks came back and neighbours joined to help.
Sam gave up on the project.
All the ducks were sold at the market.
questions.explanation: 末句 'the ducks had returned, and many of his neighbours had joined him'(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)。
